mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.2%) signal tight monetary policy and weak labor, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 4.2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 320 indicates high inflation in a late-cycle economy, prompting central bank tightening and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 320 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 indicate weak consumer demand, reducing economic activity and causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 101.0 indicates supply contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 101.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 720000) signal weak consumer demand, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 720000 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.
